rules.edge_layer_rule: edge layer equals source node logical layer
rules.graph_topology_authority: explicit source/target relationships, not numeric adjacency
rules.canonical_component_ownership: Entities whose VID begins [5,...] are canonically owned by component.internal_execution, not strategy.volarb.
rules.mount_identity: A mounted occurrence is addressed by composition_id + mount_id + canonical VID; mounting never renumbers canonical VIDs.
rules.binding_identity: Cross-component connections are composition-owned first-class bindings with immutable binding_id values.
rules.runtime_identity_separation: Runtime intent/action/order identities are not architectural VIDs.

entities.name: Internal Execution
entities.note: Broker-neutral reusable Internal Execution component. Canonical namespace [5,0,...] is strategy-agnostic and provider-agnostic; strategy placement is represented by a composition mount. Normal flow remains Margin Optimization -> Execution Slicing -> Optimal Execution with cross-cutting State Integrity, Execution Recovery/Ledger and Interrupt Control.

entities.name: Normalized MarginFeasibility -> check
entities.note: Provider implementation is external/unnumbered; this edge represents the normalized result returned by the Volarb port.

entities.name: Active Instrument Execution Registry
entities.note: Holds outstanding instrument-level economic requirements with Runtime Intent Identity/version. Registry entries are persistent requirements, not broker order tickets.

entities.name: Broker-Neutral Optimal Execution Engine
entities.note: Reusable optimal-execution algorithm over the active registry. Objective and algorithm intentionally TBD.
entities.retired_reason: Superseded by explicit layered sub-boxes: Margin Optimization followed by Optimal Execution.

entities.name: Broker Execution Port
entities.note: Broker-neutral interface implemented by unnumbered provider plug-ins such as Dhan, Kotak, or ICICI Securities.

entities.name: Normalized Broker Execution Facts
entities.note: Authoritative broker order/fill/status/account execution facts normalized before use by Internal Execution or Position Management. Exact taxonomy TBD.

entities.name: Registry -> optimal execution engine
entities.retired_reason: Superseded by direct inputs into the Margin Optimization sub-box.

entities.name: Optimal execution engine -> Broker Execution Port
entities.retired_reason: Superseded by the Time-Space Execution Sub-Box; margin-aware sequencing now releases eligible work rather than sending broker actions.

entities.name: Broker Execution Port -> normalized broker facts
Position Management intents -> Internal Execution registry
entities.note: Compatibility edge only: architectural ownership is the explicit composition binding above.

entities.name: Internal Execution facts -> Position Management
entities.note: Compatibility edge only: architectural ownership is the explicit composition binding above.

entities.name: Live Market Execution State
entities.note: Continuously refreshed normalized quotes, executable depth/order book, spread, freshness and tradability used by optimal execution.

entities.name: Live Broker Account State
entities.note: Authoritative dynamic account-capacity state including cash/collateral/margin, current positions and pending orders relevant to execution feasibility.

entities.name: Hedge / Offset Relationship Analyzer
entities.note: Infers structural risk-offset and coverage relationships from instruments, current positions and desired actions without strategy labels.

entities.name: Execution Dependency Graph
entities.note: Quantity-aware precedence constraints derived from inferred hedge relationships.

entities.name: Margin Sequence Optimizer
entities.note: Produces the Execution Ordering Plan. It decides whether precedence constraints exist. If required, emits ORDERED with sequence/quantity constraints; if genuinely unnecessary, emits UNCONSTRAINED.

entities.name: Optimal Execution
entities.note: Second Internal Execution sub-box. Enforces the sequence from Margin Optimization, then converts only the current allowed step plus live LOB/order state into time-indexed order-management actions.

entities.name: Eligible Execution Work Set
entities.note: Current execution slice(s) released after ordering and slicing constraints. Contains intent identity/version, slice identity, instrument, side and permitted quantity. Optimal Execution acts only within this set.

entities.name: Temporal Execution Controller
entities.note: Runs the time-indexed micro-execution loop, invokes the selected algorithm, validates its action, sends broker-neutral actions and consumes broker feedback.

entities.name: Execution Algorithm Port
entities.note: Plug-and-play broker-neutral micro-execution interface. Algorithms receive only the work set released under the upstream ordering decision.

entities.name: Temporal Execution Decision
entities.note: Time-t action: WAIT, PLACE_LIMIT, REPRICE_LIMIT, CANCEL_LIMIT, or PLACE_MARKET, with applicable quantity, price and order-reference fields.

entities.name: Margin Optimization -> eligible work
entities.retired_reason: Superseded by explicit Execution Sequence Plan and Sequence Enforcer.

entities.name: Execution Algorithm Port -> temporal execution decision
entities.retired_reason: Superseded by an explicit plug-in implementation between the Execution Algorithm Port and Temporal Execution Decision.

entities.name: Temporal execution decision -> Broker Execution Port
entities.retired_reason: Superseded by Command Commit Guard and durable Execution Ledger before Broker Execution Port.

entities.name: Margin Optimization
entities.note: First Internal Execution sub-box. Determines hedge/margin dependencies and releases only currently eligible instrument quantity to Optimal Execution.

entities.name: Passive Chase
entities.note: Current default Optimal Execution plug-in. Posts passively at the same-side best quote, waits T, refreshes/reprices for up to N passive cycles, then cancels/reconciles and markets the confirmed remainder.

entities.name: Passive Chase Parameters
entities.note: T = passive waiting interval between evaluations; N = maximum passive refresh cycles after initial placement. Values intentionally TBD.

entities.name: Passive Chase State
entities.note: Working order reference, confirmed remaining quantity, passive-cycle count, last passive price and last evaluation time.

entities.name: Passive Reprice Timer
entities.note: Waits parameter T between passive execution evaluations. Exact T is configuration, not architecture.

entities.name: Execution Ordering Plan
entities.note: Mandatory Margin Optimization output declaring ORDERED or UNCONSTRAINED execution. ORDERED supplies explicit precedence/sequence constraints; UNCONSTRAINED explicitly declares that no ordering constraint exists.

entities.name: Ordering Constraint Enforcer
entities.note: Interprets the Execution Ordering Plan. In ORDERED mode it releases only currently permitted step(s); in UNCONSTRAINED mode it releases all otherwise eligible work without imposing sequence. Missing/invalid ordering decision means no execution.

entities.name: Margin Sequence Optimizer -> Execution Ordering Plan
Execution Ordering Plan -> Ordering Constraint Enforcer
entities.retired_reason: Superseded by Execution Slicing between Margin Optimization and Optimal Execution.

entities.name: Ordering Constraint Enforcer -> eligible execution work set
Interrupt Control
entities.note: NVIC-inspired supervisory sub-box. Orthogonal to the normal Margin Optimization -> Optimal Execution chain and authorized to preempt both according to interrupt priority.

entities.name: Interrupt Directive
entities.note: Broker-neutral interrupt input carrying interrupt_id, level, scope, reason/source, issue time and target position/order scope. Levels currently: L1 CANCEL_WORK, L2 FLATTEN_SCOPE, L3 FLATTEN_ALL.

entities.name: Interrupt Arbiter
entities.note: Prioritizes and vectors interrupts. Higher levels preempt lower levels; normal execution is lower priority than every interrupt.

entities.name: Latched Interrupt State
entities.note: Persists active/pending interrupt priority, scope and completion state. Prevents normal convergence from recreating cancelled work until the interrupt is explicitly cleared.

entities.name: Interrupt Action Plan
entities.note: Deterministic emergency handler output: cancel working orders, flatten explicit scope, or flatten all controlled positions. Emergency flatten uses market actions for confirmed net positions after cancellation/reconciliation.

entities.name: Interrupt Action Plan -> Broker Execution Port
entities.retired_reason: Emergency mutations also pass through durable Command Commit Guard before Broker Execution Port.

entities.name: Broker facts -> Interrupt Control
entities.retired_reason: VID layer violated edge-layer rule; replaced by [5,0,4,4,10] because source is Normalized Broker Execution Facts at layer 4.

entities.name: Position Management interrupt -> Interrupt Control
entities.note: Compatibility edge only: architectural ownership is the explicit composition binding above.

entities.name: Runtime Intent Identity
entities.note: Runtime identity/version carried by each live execution requirement: intent_id, intent_version, supersedes_version/status and timestamps. Distinct from immutable architectural VIDs.

entities.name: Execution Slicing
entities.note: Normal-flow sub-box between Margin Optimization and Optimal Execution. Converts ordered/unconstrained eligible quantity into one or more execution slices. Default slice_count=1.

entities.name: Slice Planner
entities.note: Chooses number, quantity and scheduling of execution slices while preserving upstream ordering constraints. Current default: one slice; if multiple slices exist, execute sequentially.

entities.name: Execution Slice Plan
entities.note: Per-intent slice plan carrying intent identity/version, ordering metadata, slice_count, slice_id/index, quantity and scheduling policy.

entities.name: Slice Progress State
entities.note: Tracks current/complete/pending slices and authoritative filled quantity. Default sequential policy releases the next slice only after the current slice completes/reconciles.

entities.name: Slice Policy
entities.note: Slicing configuration. Current default: slice_count=1 and scheduling_mode=SEQUENTIAL. Future policies may dynamically size/schedule slices.

entities.name: Execution Slice Plan -> Ordering Constraint Enforcer
Broker facts -> Slice Progress State
entities.retired_reason: VID layer violated edge-layer rule; replaced by [5,0,4,4,9] because source is Normalized Broker Execution Facts at layer 4.

entities.name: Execution Recovery
entities.note: Cross-cutting durable execution/reconciliation sub-box. Owns write-ahead action recording, runtime identity/version validation, correlation and restart/ambiguity recovery.

entities.name: Execution Ledger
entities.note: Durable append/update record linking runtime intent/version -> slice -> execution action -> correlation/order IDs -> authoritative fills/status/positions.

entities.name: Reconciliation Engine
entities.note: Reconstructs broker truth after timeout, ambiguity or restart using authoritative orders, trades, fills and positions. No blind mutation retry while outcome is unknown.

entities.name: Command Commit Guard
entities.note: Final pre-broker mutation gate. Rejects stale intent versions, requires durable write-ahead record/correlation identity, checks interrupt latch and action-class integrity permission, then releases the command.

entities.name: Recovery State
entities.note: Tracks CLEAN, RECONCILING, AMBIGUOUS and RECOVERY_REQUIRED execution states. Normal new mutations are blocked while unresolved ambiguity exists in relevant scope.

entities.name: Execution Action Envelope
entities.note: Broker-neutral mutation envelope carrying action_id, origin/intent or interrupt identity, intent_version, slice_id, action_class, correlation_id and requested broker operation.

entities.name: Reconciliation Result
entities.note: Authoritative reconciliation result mapping attempted actions to broker orders/trades/fills/positions and exact confirmed remaining requirement.

entities.name: Temporal execution decision -> Command Commit Guard
Interrupt Action Plan -> Command Commit Guard
Command Commit Guard -> Execution Ledger write-ahead
State Integrity
entities.note: Cross-cutting broker-neutral readiness guard that classifies freshness/completeness/consistency of market, account, order/fill and recovery state before actions are allowed.

entities.name: State Integrity Guard
entities.note: Computes action-class-aware execution permission. Normal risk-adding work requires sufficiently fresh/complete state; emergency cancel/flatten uses separate minimum-integrity requirements and never silently falls back.

entities.name: Integrity Assessment
entities.note: Assessment with status VALID/STALE/INCOMPLETE/INCONSISTENT/UNKNOWN plus per-action permissions and reasons.

entities.name: Integrity State
entities.note: Current freshness/completeness/consistency state of required broker-neutral inputs.

entities.name: Provider Error Envelope
entities.note: Global broker/provider-neutral error contract consumed by any Volarb box calling an external provider. Every provider-native failure must map into a stable global category/code/outcome while retaining provider provenance; unknown native errors map to UNKNOWN rather than leaking raw exceptions.

identity_model.bound_identity: Compositions derive placement identities from composition_id + mount_id + canonical identity.
identity_model.runtime_identity: Live intent/slice/action/correlation/provider identities remain ephemeral and reference bound/canonical context.
identity_model.compatibility_rule: This file remains an assembled compatibility view; it is not the ownership authority for reusable component namespaces.
